# Kastr

> Kastr is an iPhone app for diecast car collectors. It tells you, in the store aisle, in about two seconds, whether you already own a car, whether it is a Treasure Hunt, and (soon) what it is worth. Free to download, iOS 17 or later. Independent, not affiliated with Mattel, Inc.

## What it does today

- Offline catalog of about 78,000 diecast cars, from 1968 to this year's releases. Hot Wheels first, plus Matchbox, Mini GT, Tomica, M2 Machines, Maisto and Racing Champions.
- Search by name, year, series or toy number, free and unlimited, with no signal needed.
- "Already in my garage?" badge on every search result, and a duplicate warning.
- Treasure Hunt (TH) and Super Treasure Hunt (STH) reveal with a gold animation and haptic feedback.
- Garage with price paid, place found, condition and notes; a wishlist; CSV import and export.
- Yearly TH and STH hunt guide as a photo grid, with owned cars ticked.
- Completion tracking with medals.

## Coming soon (not available yet)

- Scanning: barcode, card text, and photo recognition for loose cars.
- Values in local currency, with the number of sales behind each value and the sales themselves.
- Community feed with reporting and blocking.

## Business model

- Free to download. No ads, no ad tracking.
- Kastr Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription sold through the App Store. Prices are shown in the app.

## Data and privacy

- The collection is stored on the iPhone; an account (Sign in with Apple) is optional.
- Anonymous analytics (TelemetryDeck). Purchases via Apple and RevenueCat.
- Catalog text data comes from Fandom wikis under CC BY-SA.

## FAQ

- Does Kastr work offline? Yes, the whole catalog is stored on the iPhone.
- Is Kastr on Android? Not yet; iPhone only.
- Is Kastr affiliated with Mattel? No. Hot Wheels and Matchbox are trademarks of Mattel, Inc.
